title: The Product Filter for WooCommerce by WBW plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The Product Filter for WooCommerce by WBW plugin for WordPress contains a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'text_no_products' parameter in all versions up to and including 3.4.5. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary scripts that execute when a user interacts with a crafted link.
